app_tagline: Light for a landlord's everyday work
email_action_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
sign_in_email_intro: Sign in to Kotivalo by entering this code in the app:
sign_in_email_validity: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_email_ignore: If you didn't ask for a code, you can ignore this email. No one can get into your account without the code.
reason_email_invalid: Check the email address, for example name@example.com.
reason_code_wrong: The code isn't right. Check the code and try again.
reason_code_expired: Ask for a new code below.
reason_code_attempts_used: Ask for a new code and try again.
reason_limit_reached: Wait a moment and then try again.
reason_email_quota_title: Codes can't be sent right now
reason_email_quota: Today's sending limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.
reason_email_failed: The code couldn't be sent. Try again.
sign_in_intro: We'll email you a sign-in code. No password needed.
sign_in_new_account: A new address gets a new account.
sign_in_code_validity: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_resend_wait: You can ask for a new code in {time}.
sign_in_spam_hint: Didn't get a code? Check your spam folder.
offline_body: Kotivalo needs a network connection. Check your connection and try again.
reason_text_too_long: The text is too long. Use at most 100 characters.
reason_name_too_long: The name is too long. Use at most 50 characters.
reason_name_invalid: A name can't contain the characters @ / : < >.
reason_floor_area_invalid: Enter the floor area in square metres, for example 48.5.
reason_property_not_found: It may have been removed, or you don't have access to it.
reason_property_limit_reached: You can add at most 100 flats to Kotivalo.
properties_empty_text: Kotivalo keeps a flat's rent, costs and tax figures in one place. Start with the flat's address and size.
not_found_text: There is no page at this address. Check the address or go back to the home page.
reason_network: Check your network connection and try again.
welcome_question: What name should we show for you?
welcome_hint: Your name is shown to the people you share flats with. Your first name is enough.
reason_invitation_already_member: This address already has access to the flat.
reason_invitation_already_pending: An invitation has already been sent to this address. Cancel it first to send a new one.
reason_invitation_not_found_title: The invitation is no longer valid
reason_invitation_not_found: The owner may have cancelled it, or it has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
reason_invitation_limit_reached: A flat can have 10 open invitations. Cancel one or wait for replies.
reason_invitation_daily_limit_reached: You can send 20 invitations a day. Try again later.
reason_invitation_email_quota_title: Invitations can't be sent right now
reason_invitation_email_quota: Today's sending limit is used up. Try again tomorrow.
reason_invitation_email_failed: The invitation couldn't be sent. Try again.
reason_sharing_owner_only_title: Only the owner can do this
reason_sharing_owner_only: Inviting people and removing access are up to the flat's owner.
invitation_email_subject: You're invited to a flat in Kotivalo
invitation_email_intro: {inviter} ({inviterEmail}) shared a flat with you in Kotivalo, the app for landlords.
invitation_email_sign_in: Sign in with {email} to see and accept the invitation.
invitation_email_validity: The invitation is valid for {days} days.
invitation_email_ignore: If you don't know the sender, you can ignore this email. The flat isn't shown to you unless you accept the invitation.
sharing_owner_note: A member sees the flat and can edit its details. Only the owner can invite people and remove access.
sharing_member_note: Only the owner can invite people and remove access.
sharing_invite_hint: The invited person sees only this flat. They sign in to Kotivalo with this address and accept the invitation.
sharing_remove_dialog_text: {name} will no longer see {address}. Access can only be given back with a new invitation.
sharing_leave_dialog_text: {address} will disappear from your list. You get access again only if the owner invites you again.
